method: Actual current durable PNG opened separately at original resolution. White separation between blocks is not an object.

groups.facts: Two separate rectangular blocks, aligned approximately horizontally and separated by a visible gap. Left block has its facing/right vertical surface exposed; right block has its facing/left vertical surface exposed. No connecting bar across the gap or fixed wall.

Five solid right-pointing short arrows originate along the facing/right surface of the left block. Five solid left-pointing short arrows originate along the facing/left surface of the right block. One external arrow points left from the left block's outer face and one points right from the right block's outer face. Source labels are vector -F at left and vector F at right. No per-arrow numeric value or force multiplier is printed.

languagePlan: English/math only; preserve vector F and its minus sign. No new stress values or per-arrow calibrated magnitudes.
uncertainties: Distributed arrows are a qualitative source representation, not ten separately measured forces.
contextStatus: Do not build final context/spec/render until n50 prose freeze is available.
